summary: Adds a utility module at src/utils/sys-stats.ts that provides typed functions to retrieve memory and disk usage statistics and a helper to format byte values. Includes comprehensive unit tests.

interfaces.name: MemoryStats
DiskStats

functions.name: getMemoryStats
functions.description: Collects system memory information using Node's os module and returns a MemoryStats object. The function is async to keep a consistent API with getDiskStats, which may perform I/O.

functions.name: getDiskStats
functions.signature: export async function getDiskStats(path: string): Promise<DiskStats>
functions.description: Retrieves total, free and used disk space for the supplied path. Uses the 'diskusage' npm package (or built‑in fs.statfs on supported platforms) and returns a DiskStats object.

functions.name: formatBytes
functions.signature: export function formatBytes(bytes: number, decimals?: number): string
functions.description: Converts a byte count into a human‑readable string (e.g., 1024 → "1 KB"). Optional decimals parameter controls precision.

testCases.name: MemoryStats returns valid percentages
testCases.description: Calls getMemoryStats and asserts that total, free, used are numbers, that used = total - free (within a small delta), and that usagePercent is between 0 and 100.

testCases.name: DiskStats works for root path
testCases.description: Invokes getDiskStats('/') (or 'C:\\' on Windows) and checks that the returned object contains numeric total, free, used, usagePercent fields and that usagePercent is within 0‑100.

testCases.name: formatBytes produces expected strings
testCases.description: Verifies that formatBytes(0) === "0 Bytes", formatBytes(1024) === "1 KB", formatBytes(1536, 1) === "1.5 KB", and formatBytes(1048576) === "1 MB".
